MetaData.Value: The Address Quality Index (AQI) is used to indicate the quality of an address A - Excellent (Verifiable to at least Premise level without changes) B - Good (Verifiable to at least Thoroughfare level with minor changes) C - Average (Verifiable to at least Locality level with moderate changes) D - Poor (Only verifiable to at least Locality level with more than moderate changes) E or <lt/>blank<gt/> - Bad (If an address is unable to be parsed, the AQI can be empty)
